description: The model returns non-JSON prose instead of a structured response. With a stateless FakeLLMClient returning this same text on every attempt, every retry fails identically, exhausting max_retries and degrading to failed=true. Proves the retry-then-degrade path for a call site whose failure is BLOCKING, not INFO (see fixtures/llm/README.md's severity-divergence note) -- this candidate already survived policy and would otherwise be presentable to an engineer.
response_text: This part looks like a solid match for the requirement, I'd recommend it.

expected_stage_issue.notes: candidate_rationale failure is BLOCKING because the candidate already survived policy (tier 0 here) and would otherwise be approvable -- an unexplained recommendation is a new problem this call introduces, not a restatement of an existing one. `rationale` stays None; substitution_tier and policy_results are unaffected.
